import json,hashlib,datetime
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
read=lambda p:json.loads(Path(p).read_text())
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
m=read('/tmp/sophp-d126-full-meta.json'); assert m['status']=='finished'
r=read('/tmp/sophp-d126-full-results.json');c=read('/tmp/sophp-d126-full-collection.json');v=read('/tmp/sophp-d126-full-verification.json')
collected=Counter((x['file'],x['name']) for x in c)
actual=Counter((f['name'],' > '.join([*a['ancestorTitles'],a['title']])) for f in r['testResults'] for a in f['assertionResults'])
assert actual==collected, {'missingCount':sum((collected-actual).values()),'unexpectedCount':sum((actual-collected).values())}
inputs=read('/tmp/sophp-d126-full-inputs.json');changed=[p for p,h in inputs.items() if not Path(p).is_file() or sha(p)!=h]
cliChanged=[p for ver,p in m['runtimePaths'].items() if sha(p)!=m['runtimeSha256'][ver]]
assert not changed and not cliChanged and v['inputsUnchanged']
passed=r['numPassedTests']; total=r['numTotalTests']; failures=[{'file':f['name'],'name':a['fullName'],'failureMessages':a.get('failureMessages',[])} for f in r['testResults'] for a in f['assertionResults'] if a['status']=='failed']
proof={'verifiedAtUtc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'checkpoint':m['commit'],'files':len(r['testResults']),'tests':total,'passed':passed,'failed':r['numFailedTests'],'pending':r['numPendingTests'],'todo':r['numTodoTests'],'exitCode':m['exitCode'],'completeGreen':bool(m['exitCode']==0 and r['success'] and passed==total==1005 and len(r['testResults'])==83 and not failures and not r['numPendingTests'] and not r['numTodoTests']),'canonicalNamesMatch':True,'frozenInputs':len(inputs),'inputsAndSixRuntimesStillMatch':True,'failures':failures,'artifacts':{p:sha(p) for p in ['/tmp/sophp-d126-full-meta.json','/tmp/sophp-d126-full-inputs.json','/tmp/sophp-d126-full-collection.json','/tmp/sophp-d126-full-results.json','/tmp/sophp-d126-full-verification.json']}}
Path('/tmp/sophp-d126-canonical-proof.json').write_text(json.dumps(proof,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(proof,ensure_ascii=False));# Record the original terminal outcome even when it is not green.
assert proof['inputsAndSixRuntimesStillMatch']
